dreamSkin.unsupported.title: This platform is not supported yet
dreamSkin.unsupported.description: Codex Dream Skin currently supports the official Codex desktop app on Windows and macOS.
dreamSkin.hero.title: Give Codex a new look in one click
dreamSkin.hero.description: Choose a preset or your own artwork. The original Dream Skin runtime handles safe local injection, theme persistence, verification, and recovery.
dreamSkin.hero.safety: Local loopback injection only; the official app, app.asar, signatures, accounts, and conversations are never modified.
dreamSkin.installHint.title: First use requires one local setup
dreamSkin.installHint.description: Setup finds the running ChatGPT/Codex executable first. After you confirm, ChatGPT will close and restart automatically; no Node.js is required at runtime.
dreamSkin.restart.confirmDescription: Dream Skin will use the currently running ChatGPT/Codex path first. Save any unfinished work before continuing. If that path cannot start the skin, the default official installation is tried automatically.
dreamSkin.resources.checkingDescription: The app checks for the latest independent preset pack silently in the background.
dreamSkin.resources.downloading: Downloading skin resources in the background
dreamSkin.resources.failed: Skin resources could not be downloaded
dreamSkin.resources.failedDescription: Check your network connection and try again.
